name: diff_viz
description: Browser-native text and code diff workspace with side-by-side and unified views, semantic JSON comparison, and unified patch generation and apply. All computation runs locally through Rust/WASM.

tools.name: compute_diff
tools.description: Compute the difference between two text inputs. Returns an array of DiffLine objects with line numbers, change kind, and text content.

mode.description: Diff granularity: lines, words, or characters.

tools.name: generate_unified_diff
tools.description: Generate a standard unified diff patch (POSIX diff -u format).

left_label.description: Label for the original file in the patch header.

right_label.description: Label for the modified file in the patch header.

context_lines.description: Number of context lines around each change.

tools.name: apply_patch
tools.description: Apply a unified diff patch to original text and return the reconstructed modified text.

original.description: Original text to apply the patch to.

tools.name: json_diff
tools.description: Compute a semantic JSON diff by comparing keys and values rather than raw text positions.
